description: This file contains the implementation of a Flutter Dashboard Screen, including UI components such as headers, promo cards, feature tiles, curated lists, and bottom navigation. It defines a stateful widget for the main dashboard along with various stateless widgets for UI elements.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget representing the dashboard screen with UI layout and navigation controls.

classes.name: _HeaderRow
classes.description: Stateless widget rendering the header row with greeting and action icons.

classes.name: _HeaderTextBlock
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying the welcome message and account info.

classes.name: _CircleOutlineIconButton
classes.description: Sized icon button with circular border, used for search and notification icons.

classes.name: _HeroPromoCard
classes.description: Stateless widget for the promotional banner card with gradient background, title, subtitle, and CTA button.

classes.name: _HeroXGlowPainter
classes.description: Custom painter rendering glowing 'X' graphics on the promo card.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Displays section headers like 'Featured' and 'Curated for you'.

classes.name: _FeaturedTilesRow
classes.description: Row widget containing four feature tiles with icons and labels.

classes.name: _FeaturedTile
classes.description: Widget representing individual feature tiles with icon and label.

classes.name: _CuratedHorizontalList
classes.description: Horizontal scroll list of curated poster cards.

classes.name: _PosterCard
classes.description: Custom widget showing poster images with optional overlay X button.

classes.name: _BottomNavBar
classes.description: Bottom navigation bar with four icons and selection handling.

classes.name: _NavIcon
classes.description: Individual icon button for navigation, indicating active/inactive state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for DashboardScreen, composing the overall scaffold and layout.

methods.name: _buildIconsRow
methods.description: Builds the row of bottom navigation icons, wired to selection state.
